hooks.name: Type-check frontend TypeScript on save
hooks.description: Runs tsc --noEmit in frontend/ after a TypeScript file is saved, using the local TypeScript from node_modules (no global pnpm needed). Skips if dependencies are not installed.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$t = 'frontend/node_modules/.bin/tsc.cmd'; if (-not (Test-Path $t)) { Write-Output 'frontend/node_modules missing; install dependencies first. Skipped.'; exit 0 }; Push-Location frontend; & ./node_modules/.bin/tsc.cmd --noEmit; Pop-Location; exit 0"
